name: Global Job Source Seed Registry v2 (with agency discovery and audit tracker)
description: Curated discovery registry including source URLs, APIs, official national agency directory entries, datasets, and statistics references. NOT a live jobs database. Agency directory entries are NOT necessarily vacancy portals and no URL auto-authorizes scraping.

statuses.DOCUMENTED: Evidence found in published vendor docs or referenced research; still check terms and test endpoint
statuses.REQUIRES_VALIDATION: Observed/community source but not independently tested to work right now
statuses.DISCOVERY_TARGET: Portal or employer to discover official career feeds/ATS; no public API verified

ingestion_default: DISABLED until per-source authorization, terms, pagination, rate limits and data licensing are reviewed
